scripts.build:firefox: tsc && BROWSER=firefox vite build && cp -r _locales firefox/ && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='firefox/manifest.json';const d=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p));if(d.web_accessible_resources)d.web_accessible_resources.forEach(r=>delete r.use_dynamic_url);fs.writeFileSync(p,JSON.stringify(d,null,2))"
